articles.title: Push for Gender Equality in Tech? Some Men Say It's Gone Too Far
articles.summary: Examines backlash from men in Silicon Valley against gender equality push, covers men's rights groups, MGTOW, James Damore memo, investor reactions.

articles.title: The pinching hand: Anti-feminist backlash drives up the fever pitch of South Korea's gender wars
articles.summary: Examines South Korea's gender wars fueled by anti-feminist backlash. Young men equate feminism with hatred of men, campaign against companies using feminist imagery, major corporations capitulate.

articles.title: What Is a Woman? The dispute between radical feminism and transgenderism
articles.summary: Explores conflict between radical feminists and trans people, covers history of second-wave feminist split over trans women, TERF debates, threats against radical feminists, political inversion as trans rights gain acceptance.

hn_stories.title: Patreon Bars Anti-Feminist for Racist Speech, Inciting Revolt
hn_stories.summary: Major HN discussion about Patreon banning Sargon of Akkad for alleged racist speech. Thread covers free speech, platform censorship, deplatforming, centralization of internet infrastructure.

hn_stories.title: The More Gender Equality, the Fewer Women in STEM (2018)
